title: 867. Length of Longest Fibonacci Subsequence

examples.explanation: One longest pick is [1,2,3,5,8] since 1 + 2 = 3, 2 + 3 = 5 and 3 + 5 = 8.
The triples [1,11,12], [3,11,14] and [7,11,18] each follow the rule, and nothing longer does.
The only triple is [1,2,4] and 1 + 2 is not 4.

hints: Fix the last two positions of a candidate run; the value needed just before them is their difference, which you can look up with a value-to-index map.
Let dp[i][j] be the best run length ending with arr[i], arr[j]. If arr[j] - arr[i] appears earlier at index k, extend dp[k][i]; otherwise start a fresh pair of length 2.
